response.overview: From turning-thirty existential dread and social media burnout to nostalgic childhood throwbacks and modern dating culture, the film distills the quiet struggles and secret desires of Gen Y into a vibrant, bite-sized narrative. Blending expressive animation with deeply relatable storytelling, it delivers a heartwarming and witty tribute to modern adulthood that leaves audiences feeling seen and recharged.
response.title: (GEN Y)
